kjv: how hard is it for them that trust in riches to enter into the kingdom of God!
mine: how difficult it is to enter the kingdom of God!
note: TR adds "tous pepoithotas epi tois chremasin" ("for those who trust in riches"), softening the saying into one about attitude rather than wealth or entry as such; absent from Sinaiticus and Vaticanus.

kjv: come, take up the cross, and follow me
note: TR adds "aras ton stauron" (from 8:34); absent from Sinaiticus, Vaticanus, Bezae.

kjv: And the Pharisees came to him, and asked him
note: SBLGNT alone among the major editions omits "proselthontes Pharisaioi" (with D and some Old Latin); WH, Tregelles, NA28 and the Byzantine text all have it, so the KJV here matches most critical editions. My first draft had wrongly supplied the words; corrected to the SBLGNT text.
